items.synopsis: Traffic statistics display issue may observed on AE bundle for child links with MPC10E linecard enabled
items.description: On All Junos and Evolved platforms with MPC10E linecard enabled, the traffic statistics does not show on the AE (Aggregated Ethernet) bundle child members when the member links are deleted from the line-card, whereas the physical link would show the Input/output traffic statistics. There would not be any impact to the functionality of the service, only rate will not show when the command "show interface cli" is given.

items.synopsis: The telemetry stops streaming data when the jsd CPU utilization goes high
items.description: On Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, when it enables telemetry and uses the gRPC dial-out method, jsd might be stuck with high CPU utilization, and stop streaming data.

items.category: EVO Layer-2 switching for BCM XGS Platforms
items.synopsis: VSTP is not converging & causing a loop when IRB interfaces are configured on a VSTP enabled VLAN
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved platforms, VSTP (VLAN Spanning Tree Protocol) is not converging & causing a loop when IRB (Integrated Routing and Bridging) interfaces are configured on a VSTP enabled VLAN. The issue happens for the input ifl index value with the L2 ifl index being overwritten by the IRB ifl index.

items.category: EVO L3 routing for BCM XGS Platforms
items.synopsis: PFE crash seen on Junos OS Evolved platforms due to upstream interface change
items.description: On all Junos OS Evolved platforms, PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine) process crashes when the upstream interface for a multicast route changes from L3 (Layer 3) interface to another L3 interface or from L3 to an IRB (Integrated Routing and Bridging) interface. This can happen when the RPF (Reverse Path Forwarding) to the source changed due to an interface going down in the upstream path. A complete loss of traffic is observed till the PFE process restarts post the crash.

items.synopsis: FPCs experiences crash and restart whenever the network encounters either an MPLS LSP flap or a LAG flap
items.description: On all Junos Evolved platforms face potential network instability due to two issues: FPC(Flexible PIC Concentrators) crashes during network flaps and brief disruptions during route updates with unilists.

items.synopsis: L2TPV3 load-balancing not working properly and create out of order packet flow.
items.description: L2TP (Layer 2 tunneling Protocol) session ID is used for load balancing hash-key. 8 Bytes got extracted while the Session ID is 4 Byte. The other 4 bytes are from the cookie part and if this portion is random the L2TP packet flow will be balanced instead of using a single link and may cause out of order packet flow

items.synopsis: PTX10K EVO platforms with high multicast route changes can trigger multicast traffic queue drops
items.description: Due to pfe internal logging processing time of multicast next-hop changes, multicast route convergence might take longer on one FPC versus other FPCs in the same system. This can cause multicast traffic amplification resulting in multicast traffic queue drops. The condition is transient and may last for sub-seconds to seconds.

items.synopsis: Core dumps for pfex and dot1x seen due to dot1x authentication
items.description: On all Junos platforms, core dumps for Pfex and dot1x will be seen, when dot1x is authenticated. It is a scenario of basic authentication where EAP ( Extensible Authentication Protocol ) packets are being received from the client.

items.synopsis: The FPC crash is observed on Junos MX10008 platform when connected to non-Juniper SFP
items.description: On Junos MX10008 platform, the FPC (Flexible PIC Concentrator) crash will be observed when connected to non-Juniper SFP (Small Form-factor Pluggable) and it will lead to traffic loss.

items.synopsis: STP bridge domain/ERPS protected domain configured on the IRB interface causes traffic to be dropped
items.description: On Junos Evolved ACX7K platforms, With any one of the STP/RSTP/ERPS (Spanning Tree Protocol/Rapid STP/Ethernet Ring Protection Switching) bridge or protected domains configured on the IRB interface, whenever ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) on IRB refresh takes place, ARP packet will flood on both blocked (backup path) & unblocked (working path) ports in a ring node. ARP packet is being allowed in the block port, causing traffic disruption.

items.synopsis: In the scaled L2circuit configured with L2circuit redundancy configuration traffic drops may be observed
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved ACX platforms, in the scaled L2circuit (Layer 2 Circuit) configured (200+ L2circuits) with L2circuit redundancy configuration traffic drops may be observed on a few instances only when deactivating/activating IGP (Interior Gateway Protocol) protocol or restart routing.

items.synopsis: AE load balancing issue on Junos Evolved ACX7K platforms
items.description: On all Junos Evolved ACX7K platforms, when IPv6 is tunnelled over IPV4 and hash key "MPLS all-label" is enabled with "family inet6 layer-3 hash key", the egress traffic load balancing does not work for IPv6 traffic over IPV4.

items.synopsis: Duplicate IPv4 address detection error not logged on syslog for Junos Evolved platforms
items.description: On all Junos Evolved platforms, duplicate IPv4 (Internet Protocol Version 4) address detection error is not logged on syslog.

items.synopsis: Firewall modification will cause the AFTman crash
items.description: On all Junos Evolved platforms, modifying multiple firewall filters followed by the commit and use of load update to apply changes will lead to aftman crash. Traffic is not impacted as the issue is due to an invalid config.

items.category: Issues related to EVO dependency layer including object graphs, incompletes, anomalies and nkdb
items.synopsis: Lost connectivity to management IP address after abnormal Routing Engine (RE) shuts down, and new Master RE won't own the IP either.
items.description: Master-only IP address is missing on mgmt-0 interface after the master Routing-Engine abnormally shuts down, which causes the router not be accessible remotely via mgmt-0 IP address.

items.synopsis: [Junos OS Evolved] Committed configuration files are not preserved post software version rollback operation
items.description: On all Junos OS Evolved platforms, committed configuration files are not preserved post software version rollback operation. The actual configuration is not affected.

items.synopsis: Software upgrade with force option tries to recover space for /var partition and the upgrade fails
items.description: On all Junos Evolved platforms, while doing the upgrade with force option, it is observed that the upgrade checks for /var partition and when /var partition is 80% full, older versions are deleted to recover the space. However, still the upgrade fails and not completed.

items.synopsis: We may encounter jdhcpd core during initialization. The core in rare, and there is no service impact because of this core (as the process recovers immediately)
items.description: We may encounter jdhcpd core during initialization. The core in rare, and there is no service impact because of this core (as the process recovers immediately)

items.synopsis: On QFX Series platforms running Junos OS Evolved that support EVPN, on which EVPN feature support was introduced with MAC-VRF EVPN instances, you configure EVPN-VXLAN features using MAC-VRF instances only
items.description: On QFX Series platforms running Junos OS Evolved that support EVPN, on which EVPN feature support was introduced with MAC-VRF EVPN instances, you configure EVPN-VXLAN features using MAC-VRF instances only

items.synopsis: Data center interconnect configuration addition needs to be non-catastrophic.
items.description: Adding interconnect configuration can be catastrophic behaviour which means BD (Bridge domain) and routing instance object will be deleted and added back, during this window there will be traffic drop.

items.synopsis: Backup RE reset followed by Master RE reset traffic loss will be observed on AE links
items.description: On Junos Evolved ACX7509 platform, after the Backup RE (Routing Engine) reset, lacpd ((Link Aggregation Control Protocol Deamon) communication with Backup RE will have issues. When the Backup RE comes up and becomes a new Master RE after the previous Master RE reset, traffic loss will be observed due to an incorrect lacpd state.

items.synopsis: The pfe process crashes on Junos OS Evolved ACX7100 platforms when MACSec is enabled on an interface with unsupported port speed
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved ACX7100 platforms, the pfe (Packet Forwarding Engine) process will crash when unsupported port speed is configured and MACSec (MAC Security) is enabled on the interface configured with unsupported port speed. Due to this issue, there will be complete traffic loss of forwarding traffic till the pfe process restarts.

items.category: PRs related to software Agentd daemon on EVO
items.synopsis: ACX7024 is not booting after request system zeroize
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved ACX7024, when performing "request system zeroize", disk operation related command will consume more time than 500s thus results kernel panic. The solution is provided through this PR to periodically reset the watchdog with upper limit. This provides additional buffer time for the command to complete.

items.synopsis: Observed "MCNHMBB index availability" alarm when system is subjected to heavy PIM join/prune churn
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved platforms, During heavy multicast route changes or PIM join/prune churn, MCNHMBB (Multicast NextHop Make Before Break) index space is running low and will flow control back to RPD (Routing Protocol Daemon). This is not a bug, a small enhancement.

items.category: EVO Netstack Socket Intercept and NetIO libraries
items.synopsis: DNS resolution is not working for default instance when name server is reachable through mgmt_junos VRF
items.description: DNS resolution is not working for default instance when name server is reachable through mgmt_junos VRF

items.synopsis: [Junos OS Evolved] Traceoptions log sometimes shows UTC timestamp, although non UTC time-zone is configured
items.description: On all Junos OS Evolved platforms, traceoptions log sometimes shows UTC timestamp, although non UTC time-zone is configured.

items.synopsis: snmpd-subagent cored
items.description: , This issue is a seen very rarely when jnxCos related mibs are queried at a high rate and FPCs are down/unable to respond back to the query.

items.synopsis: Migrating from L2 Circuit to EVPN results in rpd crash
items.description: On Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, when migration from Layer 2 Circuit to EVPN (Ethernet Virtual Private Network) is performed in a single commit, segmentation fault and rpd (Routing Protocol Process) crash will be observed resulting in traffic loss.

items.synopsis: With protocol ISIS configured, any new LSP generation triggers SPF
items.description: On all Junos platforms, with ISIS configured, when commit or any operation that attempts for LSP generation, an SPF is triggered.

items.synopsis: ARP resolution issues will be observed in the H-VPLS environment
items.description: On Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, traffic impact will be observed due to ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) resolution issues when multiple mesh-group is configured under the same routing-instance and the name of each mesh-group is not unique i.e. substring of another mesh-group in the H-VPLS (Hierarchical Virtual Private LAN Service) environment.

items.synopsis: The l2ald process will crash, with rapid configuration changes followed by rpd and l2ald restart process
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms with EVPN -VXLAN and high scaling configuration, rapid configuration changes followed by restart of rpd and l2ald will result in l2ald process crash and traffic drop will be observed.

items.category: Port-based link layer security services and protocols that a
items.synopsis: MACsec interoperability issue between Juniper and non Juniper platforms
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms with MACsec (Media Access Control security) configured , frequent SAK (Secure Association Key) rollover is observed when the peer device is a non-Juniper box and the Juniper device is acting as the key-server. This results in unstable MACsec sessions between the juniper device and the non Juniper device.

items.category: Port-based link layer security services and protocols that a
items.synopsis: Port remains down after flapping or configuration change until the OAM is cleared
items.description: On Junos and Junos Evolved platforms with MACsec (Media Access Control security) and LFM (Link Fault Management) (OAM - Operation, Administration, and Management) configured, after link flap or deactivate/activate "exclude-protocol lacp" is performed, the port remains down until the OAM state is cleared.

items.synopsis: PFE disable on certain Junos MX platforms will bring down all logical IFDs tunnel/inline services
items.description: On Junos MX platforms with MPC10E/MPC11E line cards, Packet Forwarding Engine (PFE) disable on pfe-0 (instance 0), will cause all inline service/tunnel logical (IFDs) to be marked down. Conversely, on other PFEs (than inst 0), PFE disable does not bring down any non local inline services/tunnel IFLs. Expectation is that all tunnel/services IFDs local to the pfe instance must be bought down., however, all tunnel/services IFDs (both local and non-local) are marked down.

items.synopsis: The rpd process crash is observed when MVPN PE receives PIM join messages from the remote peers
items.description: On all Junos Evolved platforms, when MVPN (Multicast Virtual Private Network) configured device receives PIM join or IGMP report from the remote peer installs route in next-hop and not in multicast composite next-hop, causing the rpd process to crash.

items.synopsis: On Junos and Junos Evolved platforms the rpd crashed abnormally and later chassisd crashed as well
items.description: On Junos and Junos Evolved platforms configuring BGP causes the rpd to crash abnormally and later chassisd crashes too.

items.category: RPD Next-hop issues including indirect, CNH, and MCNH
items.synopsis: Policy Evaluation causing unrelated route flaps in Dynamic Tunnel setup
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms that support Dynamic tunnels, a policy evaluation of the routing policy causes flaps for unrelated tunnel routes. The route flap for the tunnel route will cause traffic loss.

items.synopsis: The rpd process crashes with firewall filter configuration
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, the rpd process crashes when firewall filter is configured. Due to this all the routing protocols will be impacted causing traffic loss.

items.category: RPD route tables, resolver, routing instances, static routes
items.synopsis: Memory spike will be observed on the system with BFD enabled
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, when Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD) is enabled with any routing protocols (ex - IS-IS/OSPF), memory spikes will be observed in the system.

items.synopsis: Next Hop counts are not as expected
items.description: Next Hop counts are not as expected

items.category: Issues related to control plane security
items.synopsis: Enhancement to add option to IMA keys deletion command (force option)
items.description: The existing CLI 'request security system-keystore unlink ' would now not delete the key if there are third-party packages that require this key. This CLI will now display a message as shown below :root@EVOvSCAPA1-RE0-re0> request security system-keystore unlink ima-key-1 Following packages require 'ima-key-1': custom_logger 2.0.2 multi_app_package_sysman 3.0.3Key 'ima-key-1' not removed. Use 'force' to force removal. A new 'force' option is now introduced to this CLI command to force the removal of a key if required.

items.category: PFE COS features on BT based platforms
items.synopsis: More than 8 forwarding-classes cannot be configured with CBF
items.description: On PTX10001-36MR, error will be displayed when we commit more than 8 forwarding-classes (FCs) which are configured with Class Based Forwarding (CBF) even though the product supports upto 16 forwarding-classes configured with CBF.

items.synopsis: The evo-pfemand process is observed to crash on Junos Evolved platforms with LACP configuration
items.description: JDI_REG:EVO:ultron: evo-pfemand.re cored at futex_abstimed_wait_cancelable (private=0, abstime=0x7fd17582c870, clockid=0, expected=0, futex_word=0x7fd1479fb570) at ../sysdeps/unix/sysv/linux/futex-internal.h:208

items.synopsis: Layer 2 loop can be seen on ACX EVO platforms after reboot
items.description: On Junos Evolved ACX platforms L2 (Layer 2) loop can be seen in the network after a device reboot/power cycle or 'evo-pfemand' process restart in ERPS setup (Ethernet Ring Protection Switching). This issue is seen because the physical ring ports which are part of the STP (Spanning Tree Protocol) default instance are considered non-STP ports and set in a forwarding state. The L2 loop will cause a traffic drop.

items.synopsis: Any MPLS encapsulated packet with a size less than and equal to 35 bytes is getting dropped
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved ACX7024 and ACX7024X platforms, any MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching) encapsulated packet with a size less than or equal to 35 bytes on the 25G/10G/1G ports [Port No 4 to 27] will get dropped. The issue can also be observed in the PPPoE (Point-to-Point Protocol over Ethernet) over L2circuit (Layer 2 circuit) scenario.

items.synopsis: JDI-RCT: ACX/AMX:Guardian: Local route itself reject
items.description: Disable and Enable IRB interface will resolve the issue.

items.synopsis: Ipv6 transit traffic statics output is missing
items.description: Ipv6 transit traffic statics output is missing

items.synopsis: sflow collector which ipv4 based not working for Ipv4 address but the same is working for Ipv6
items.description: sflow collector stats is not working correctly when it configured based on ipv4 address but collector works fine when it configured with ipv6 address.

items.synopsis: Telemetry data is not exported in an IS-IS scaled Segment Routing scenario
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms configured with SR-ISIS and with gRPC/gNMI telemetry, subscription to the path: "/junos/services/segment-routing/sid/usage/" will not work and the output could not be proper. The issue could happen only in scaled configuration (Approximately, 4000 or more per-sid ingress sensors and 4000 or more IPv4/IPv6 per-sid egress sensors are configured).

items.category: JDHCP daemon for EVO platform to handle DHCP protocol
items.synopsis: EVO(EVPN Fabric): DHCP packets are getting relayed even after deleting the dhcp relay configuration from the leaf
items.description: TBA

items.synopsis: Install L2 related functions JSU package may cause the Junos Evolved platform to not boot up correctly
items.description: L2 related daemons - lacpd, ifmand, and arpd - when patched using JSU may cause the Junos Evolved router to not boot up.

items.synopsis: Junos Evolved software:: System is hanging when extend-db is configured and config > 680MB is loaded.
items.description: In EVO, during scaled config commit, Configd daemon in UI-infra is taking more time to process the commit. To optimise the processing time, most likely there will be design change required. There is no LKWR/pass instance. Also based on the configuration scale and the time taken for the commit to complete, it seems that this is a Day-1 issue.

items.synopsis: Neighbor device details not listed under snmp walk [ipNetToMediaPhysAddress]
items.description: On Junos Evolved platforms, SNMP walk table (ipNetToMediaPhysAddress) is not updated when a neighbour entry is configured.

items.synopsis: The traffic rate for member of aggregated ethernet with class-of-service configured does not apply the policer
items.description: When class-of-service with shaping rate is configured on Aggregate Ethernet interfaces, and the firewall policer queries the AE member and not the AE interface, the shaping rate or the policy configuration does not take effect as the shaping rate is not configured in AE member.

items.synopsis: TTL value of the explicit null label is ignored on certain PTX platforms
items.description: TTL value of the explicit null label is ignored on certain PTX platforms.

items.synopsis: RLI53385: acx7332: After multiple reboots, GL is stuck and after power cycle seeing picd and vmcore
items.description: RLI53385: acx7332: After multiple reboots, GL is stuck and after power cycle seeing picd and vmcore

items.category: Issues related to Junos licensing infrastructure
items.synopsis: License-service crash is seen on Junos OS Evolved platforms
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved platforms, when license with unknown feature ID/platform reserved feature ID is added via configuration set system license keys key and then if License-service is restarted or system is rebooted or software upgrade is done then license service crashes and crash files are seen. This is a non service impacting issue.

items.synopsis: When sBFD responder is configured with local-discriminator, it is observed that sBFD responder sessions fail to work and throw error message
items.description: On all Junos Evolved platforms, when the sBFD (seamless Bidirectional Forwarding Detection) responder is configured with local-discriminator, the Loopback interface (lo0) value is set to 0 causing error messages and improper working of the sBFD responder.

items.synopsis: QFX5700 MacSec: MKA sessions may take upto 15s to establish after config commit
items.description: On QX5700, MKA session establishment may be delayed by up to 15s after the config commit.

items.category: Category for QFX5K EVO Platform Software PRs related to Chas
items.synopsis: Intermittently Traffic gets blackholed on line side Tx/Rx on certain platforms
items.description: On a rare scenario, platforms having Marvell PHY (Alaska 88x7121P ) such as ACX7348, QFX5700, ACX7100-32C, ACX7100-48L etc, intermittently traffic gets blackholed on line side Tx/Rx, when device is is fully loaded/populated with optics/DAC cables and is rebooted.

items.category: Category for QFX5K EVO Platform Software PRs related to Chas
items.synopsis: CLI start shell puts the system in 'csh'
items.description: Please refer to TSB69736

items.category: RPD Next-hop issues including indirect, CNH, and MCNH
items.synopsis: The rpd crash is observed due to segment fault
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved platforms, when no acknowledgment is received from PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine) within timeout results in the rpd (Routing Process Daemon) crash. This issue happens when routes requesting acknowledgment do not receive acknowledgment leading to segment fault.

items.category: PTX10K Line Card specific interface PRs
items.synopsis: Interface stay in link DOWN state when using third party optics
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved platforms and MX ULC based line cards, interfaces will stay DOWN when using third party vendor optics, due to an incorrect programming of EEPROM when plugged into the device.

items.category: Issues related to control plane security
items.synopsis: UEFI BIOS Key synchronization tool - efitools.service failed after optics diagnostics test
items.description: The efitools.service failed since the EFI data structure is set to be immutable in the JUNOS WRL version 9.x

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: unexpected commit error - error: VLAN-ID must be specified on tagged ethernet interfaces
items.description: unexpected commit error like 'error: VLAN-ID must be specified on tagged ethernet interfaces', due to 'commit check' reset internal flag incorrectly after load overide configuration in rare condition.
